record.question: Which of the following is classified as a nootropic drug?
record.explanation: Answer C: Piracetam. Piracetam is classified as a nootropic in some pharmacological references, although clinical efficacy and regulatory status vary by country. Source/context note: Nootropic is a broad and sometimes non-regulatory category; piracetam is not approved for all claimed uses. Reference: https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/medicines/human/referrals/piracetam. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
